title: Building a Sanctuary, Coming Home to Continuous Practice
speaker: Joden Bob Rose
summary: Joden Bob Rose emphasizes that spiritual growth requires steady practice and embracing limitations as opportunities for creativity and freedom. By cultivating a regular zazen practice, individuals can develop a healthy habit for mind and body, even in challenging circumstances like the pandemic. This approach encourages finding joy and meaning in simple acts, such as sitting in space, and practicing respect for all things, including one's own life.
